WITH signups AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         signup_date,
         date_trunc('week', signup_date) AS cohort_week
  FROM workspace.exam_xf1866.signups
),
cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT cohort_week, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cohort_size
  FROM signups
  GROUP BY cohort_week
),
activity_with_week AS (
  SELECT s.user_id,
         s.cohort_week,
         s.signup_date,
         a.activity_date,
         FLOOR(DATEDIFF(a.activity_date, s.signup_date) / 7) AS week_n
  FROM signups s
  JOIN workspace.exam_xf1866.activity a
    ON s.user_id = a.user_id
  WHERE a.activity_date >= s.signup_date
    AND FLOOR(DATEDIFF(a.activity_date, s.signup_date) / 7) BETWEEN 0 AND 4
),
active_counts AS (
  SELECT cohort_week, week_n, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users
  FROM activity_with_week
  GROUP BY cohort_week, week_n
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT 0 AS week_n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
),
cohort_weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cohort_week FROM signups
),
full_grid AS (
  SELECT cw.cohort_week, w.week_n
  FROM cohort_weeks cw CROSS JOIN weeks w
),
joined AS (
  SELECT fg.cohort_week,
         fg.week_n,
         co.cohort_size,
         COALESCE(ac.active_users, 0) AS active_users,
         ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(ac.active_users, 0) / co.cohort_size, 1) AS retention_pct
  FROM full_grid fg
  JOIN cohort_sizes co ON fg.cohort_week = co.cohort_week
  LEFT JOIN active_counts ac ON fg.cohort_week = ac.cohort_week AND fg.week_n = ac.week_n
)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xf1866.x1_retention AS
SELECT cohort_week, cohort_size, week_n, active_users, retention_pct
FROM joined
ORDER BY cohort_week, week_n;
